card.title: Effortless Insider
card.instruction: Treat someone’s effortless movement through systems and customs as both impressive and threatening, then prove you can master every rule without help.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: How did you get into the members' lounge without showing your pass?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Right. I'll learn every doorman's birthday. Systematically.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No, thank you. I'd like to develop spontaneous rapport properly.

mechanism: A sees B's effortless lounge entry as a challenge and tries to engineer rapport independently rather than accept an introduction.
confusable: Unlike simply wanting insider access, A must resist help in order to prove mastery comparable to B's natural ease.
comparison: The lounge alternative systematizes personal familiarity; the banquet alternative performs memorized utensil signals rather than borrow B's guidance.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
